events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p='sample.swap.rna.q1.tsv.gz'
df=pd.read_csv(p,sep='\\t',index_col=0)
# cpm-like; compute log2((mean in group+1e-5)/(mean other+1e-5))
cols=df.columns
# scale each column? sums approx equal; use raw
for col in cols:
    a=df[col].values
    b=(df.drop(columns=col).sum(axis=1)).values
    # total per group mean with same total? compare rates: a/sumA, b/sumB
    rate_a=a/df[col].sum(); rate_b=b/df.drop(columns=col).values.sum()
    lfc=np.log2((rate_a+1e-6)/(rate_b+1e-6))
    idx=np.argsort(-lfc)[:25]
    print('\\n###',col)
    for i in idx:
        print(df.index[i], 'lfc=%.2f'%lfc[i], 'val=%.1f'%a[i], 'other=%.3f'%(b[i]/ (len(cols)-1)))
PY"

import re, json, sys
path='ref3/ncbi_dataset/data/GCA_927797965.1/genomic.gbff'
out='gbff_id_gene.json'
pat_id=re.compile(r'\\bID:(BLAG\\d+)(?:[_;]|"'$)'"')
pat_gene=re.compile(r'/gene=\"(["'^"]+)"'"')
pat_locus=re.compile(r'/locus_tag=\"(["'^"]+)"'"')
mapping={}
current_gene=None
current_locus=None
count=0
with open(path, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
    for line in f:
        stripped=line.strip()
        m=pat_gene.search(stripped)
        if m:
            current_gene=m.group(1)
        m=pat_locus.search(stripped)
        if m:
            current_locus=m.group(1)
        # A new feature? current gene persists; if ID line then map
        for m in pat_id.finditer(stripped):
            gid=m.group(1)
            if gid not in mapping:
                mapping[gid]={'gene':current_gene,'locus':current_locus}
                count+=1
            elif current_gene and mapping[gid]['gene'] is None:
                mapping[gid]['gene']=current_gene
                mapping[gid]['locus']=current_locus
print('mapped',count,'ids')
json.dump(mapping, open(out,'w'))
print('saved',out)
PY

# map our labels to original cell_type patterns
patterns={
 'endoderm':['endoderm'],
 'endostyle_csg':['endostyle_csg'],
 'epidermal_neural':['epidermal_neural1','epidermal_neural2'],
 'epidermis':['epidermis_1','epidermis_2'],
 'mesodermal_notochord':['mesodermal_notochord'],
 'muscular_somites':['muscular_somites'],
 'neural':['neural'],
 'neural_like':['neural_like1','neural_like2'],
 'putative_neuro_endo':['putative_neuro_endo'],
 'somite':['somite'],
 'tailbud':['tailbud'],
 'tailbud_neural':['tailbud_neural'],
}
ann['group']=ann['cell_type'].map(lambda x: next((k for k,vals in patterns.items() if x in vals), None))
print(ann['group'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Load our genes
our=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q1.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
our_genes=set(our.index)
print('our genes',len(our_genes))

# Open sc_counts, process rows
path='ref/sc_counts.tsv.gz'
fin=gzip.open(path,'rt')
header=fin.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
# map cell->group
cell_group={}
for cell,g in zip(ann['cell'],ann['group']):
    cell_group[cell]=g
# Some cells in header not annotations? check
missing=[c for c in header if c not in cell_group]
print('header cells',len(header),'missing annotations',len(missing),missing[:5])
groups=list(patterns.keys())
group_sums={g:np.zeros(len(header),dtype=np.float64) for g in groups}

gidx=np.array([groups.index(cell_group.get(c)) if cell_group.get(c) in groups else -1 for c in header], dtype=np.int32)
counts_per_group=np.bincount(gidx[gidx>=0], minlength=len(groups))
print('counts per group',dict(zip(groups,counts_per_group.tolist())))

kept=[]
kept_sums={g:np.zeros(len(our_genes), dtype=np.float64) for g in groups}
kept_idx={gene:i for i,gene in enumerate(our.index)}

    for g_index,g in enumerate(groups):
        mask=(gidx==g_index)
        kept_sums[g][gi]=vals[mask].sum()
    n+=1
    if n%2000==0:
        print('"'processed',n,'our rows',flush=True)
fin.close()
ref=pd.DataFrame(kept_sums, index=our.index)
# normalize each col CPM (per million) like our file maybe sum to 1e6
ref_cpm=ref/ref.sum(axis=0, skipna=True)*1e6
ref_cpm.to_csv('reference_pseudobulk.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',compression='gzip')

our=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q1.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
ref=pd.read_csv('reference_pseudobulk.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0,compression='gzip')
for oc,rc in [('epidermal_neural','tailbud_neural'),('tailbud_neural','epidermal_neural'),('epidermal_neural','epidermal_neural'),('tailbud_neural','tailbud_neural')]:
    a=our[oc]; b=ref[rc]
    print(oc,'vs ref',rc)
    print('pearson raw',np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1], 'spearman?')
    print('sum our/ref',a.sum(),b.sum())
    # max abs diff scaled
    scale=b.sum()/a.sum()
    print('scale',scale)
    # if proportional, log1p pearson
    print('log1p pearson',np.corrcoef(np.log1p(a),np.log1p(b))[0,1])
    print('max relative diff for nonzero', np.max(np.abs(a*scale-b)/(b+1e-9)))
    print('head')
    print(pd.DataFrame({'our':a,'ref':b}).head(10))
PY"
